AI is great at summarizing science but poor at explaining when it's unsettled, warns Cato's @dr4liberty. Ask a chatbot if kratom or 7-OH can be dangerous, and it might sound certain — but researchers are still actively debating the question. The fix isn't more government regulation. It's transparency, open debate, and healthy skepticism.
